editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood cafecito tucked inside the L stop, known for excellent cubanos, potent espresso drinks, and freshly made pastries.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early to beat the rush that often backs out into the station; order a large latte only if you want two double shots of espresso and serious caffeine.

topDishes.note: among the best reviewers have had
thick, creamy, with deep and bold flavor
